# Quest Idle

> A hilarious automated text-based idle RPG with randomized adventures across timelines — from medieval to cyberpunk — with anime flair, permadeath, and absurd companions.

Quest Idle plays itself: send a hero on procedurally generated quests, recruit companions, accumulate bonds, and immortalize their (often ridiculous) deaths in the morgue.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Start a new adventure or continue an existing save.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top deaths, longest lives, and most bizarre equipment.
- [Sign In](/auth): Sign in or create an account to sync saves and post scores.
